## Example Usage - Designcenter Component Basic


```hcl
resource "google_design_center_component" "example" {
  project                      = "my-project-name"
  location                     = "us-central1"
  space                        = "my-space"
  application_template         = "my-application-template"
  component_id                 = "example-component"
  display_name                 = "Example Component"
  shared_template_revision_uri = "projects/gcpdesigncenter/locations/us-central1/spaces/googlespace/sharedTemplates/1b5e09c8-780f-484e-b8ed-c7178f4e4342/revisions/r-24"

  parameters {
    key   = "service_name"
    value = jsonencode("example-service")
  }

  parameters {
    key   = "location"
    value = jsonencode("us-central1")
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location of the component.

* `space` -
  (Required)
  The space of the component.

* `application_template` -
  (Required)
  The application_template of the component.

* `component_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the component.


* `shared_template_revision_uri` -
  (Optional)
  The URI of the shared template revision that the component is built
  from.

* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  The display name of the component.

* `parameters` -
  (Optional)
  The parameters of the component.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_parameters).

* `application_info` -
  (Optional)
  The App Hub application associated with the component. Only supported for
  components in `COMPOSITE` application templates. The API ignores this
  field when it creates a component from an application template revision,
  so set it in a later update for such components.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_application_info).

* `use_as_root_module` -
  (Optional)
  Whether the component is exported as a separate Terraform root module in
  a `COMPOSITE` application template.

* `application_template_revision_uri` -
  (Optional)
  The URI of the application template revision that the component is built
  from. Only supported in `COMPOSITE` application templates.

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_parameters"></a>The `parameters` block supports:

* `key` -
  (Required)
  The key of the parameter.

* `value` -
  (Optional)
  The value of the parameter, as a JSON-encoded string. Use
  `jsonencode()` to set it.

<a name="nested_application_info"></a>The `application_info` block supports:

* `apphub_application_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the App Hub application.

* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  The display name of the App Hub application.

* `scope` -
  (Optional)
  The scope of the App Hub application.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_application_info_scope).

* `attributes` -
  (Optional)
  Attributes of the App Hub application.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_application_info_attributes).

* `deployment_region` -
  (Optional)
  The deployment region of the component. For `REGIONAL` scope, the App
  Hub application is created in this region, such as `us-central1`.


<a name="nested_application_info_scope"></a>The `scope` block supports:

* `type` -
  (Required)
  Scope type. Possible values are `REGIONAL` and `GLOBAL`.

<a name="nested_application_info_attributes"></a>The `attributes` block supports:

* `criticality` -
  (Optional)
  Criticality of the application.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_application_info_attributes_criticality).

* `environment` -
  (Optional)
  Environment of the application.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_application_info_attributes_environment).

* `developer_owners` -
  (Optional)
  Developer team that owns development and coding.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_application_info_attributes_developer_owners).

* `operator_owners` -
  (Optional)
  Operator team that ensures runtime and operations.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_application_info_attributes_operator_owners).

* `business_owners` -
  (Optional)
  Business team that ensures user needs are met and value is
  delivered.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_application_info_attributes_business_owners).


<a name="nested_application_info_attributes_criticality"></a>The `criticality` block supports:

* `type` -
  (Required)
  Criticality type. Possible values are `MISSION_CRITICAL`,
  `HIGH`, `MEDIUM` and `LOW`.

<a name="nested_application_info_attributes_environment"></a>The `environment` block supports:

* `type` -
  (Required)
  Environment type. Possible values are `PRODUCTION`, `STAGING`,
  `TEST` and `DEVELOPMENT`.

<a name="nested_application_info_attributes_developer_owners"></a>The `developer_owners` block supports:

* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  Contact's name.

* `email` -
  (Required)
  Email address of the contact.

<a name="nested_application_info_attributes_operator_owners"></a>The `operator_owners` block supports:

* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  Contact's name.

* `email` -
  (Required)
  Email address of the contact.

<a name="nested_application_info_attributes_business_owners"></a>The `business_owners` block supports:

* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  Contact's name.

* `email` -
  (Required)
  Email address of the contact.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/applicationTemplates/{{application_template}}/components/{{component_id}}`

* `name` -
  The resource name of the component.

* `roles` -
  The roles of the component.

* `apis` -
  The APIs of the component.

* `connections_parameters` -
  The parameters of the connections of the component.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_connections_parameters).

* `component_parameter_schema` -
  The component parameter schema, which lists the parameters the component
  accepts.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_component_parameter_schema).

* `create_time` -
  Create time stamp.

* `update_time` -
  Update time stamp.

## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


Component can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/applicationTemplates/{{application_template}}/components/{{component_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{space}}/{{application_template}}/{{component_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{space}}/{{application_template}}/{{component_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import Component using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    location = "<-required value->"
    space = "<-required value->"
    application_template = "<-required value->"
    component_id = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_design_center_component.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import Component using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/applicationTemplates/{{application_template}}/components/{{component_id}}"
  to = google_design_center_component.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), Component can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_design_center_component.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/applicationTemplates/{{application_template}}/components/{{component_id}}
$ terraform import google_design_center_component.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{space}}/{{application_template}}/{{component_id}}
$ terraform import google_design_center_component.default {{location}}/{{space}}/{{application_template}}/{{component_id}}
```
